About One Pass

One Pass is redefining how people engage with health, wellness, and everyday living. Through a comprehensive engagement and loyalty platform, we empower millions of members to live healthier, more connected lives. Backed by deep partnerships across healthcare and supported by a culture of innovation, cross‑functional collaboration, and relentless curiosity, One Pass is scaling rapidly and shaping the future how people lead healthier, fuller lives.

One Pass is seeing an experienced and strategic Marketing Manager to play a key role in driving growth, awareness, and engagement for One Pass across both consumer and business audiences. This individual will support the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies that strengthen the One Pass brand, generate demand, and equip clients with compelling marketing tools that drive enrollment and utilization. The ideal candidate is a well-rounded marketer with 4-6 years of experience spanning B2B2C marketing, brand management, lead generation, and client-facing marketing support. They are highly organized, data-driven, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

B2B Marketing & Lead Generation

  • Support demand generation programs targeted toward health plans, employers, brokers, and other strategic audiences.

  • Develop and execute lead generation campaigns across digital, content, events, and partner channels.

  • Partner with growth team to create marketing programs that accelerate pipeline growth.

  • Measure marketing performance and report on key lead generation metrics, campaign effectiveness, and ROI.

Client Marketing & Collateral Development

  • Develop client-specific marketing materials that support member acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Customize campaign assets to align with client brands, audiences, and market needs.

  • Manage production and distribution of marketing toolkits, communication materials, and enrollment resources.

  • Collaborate with growth and account management teams to support key client initiatives and launches.

  • Ensure all materials meet brand, compliance, and quality standards.

Brand & Consumer Marketing

  • Support development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that drive awareness, consideration, and engagement for One Pass.

  • Manage brand initiatives and ensure consistent messaging across all consumer touchpoints.

  • Collaborate with creative, product, and digital teams to develop compelling marketing assets and campaigns.

  • Help evolve brand positioning and value propositions based on market trends, customer insights, and business priorities.

  • Monitor campaign performance and provide recommendations for optimization.

Market Insights & Performance Optimization

  • Analyze campaign performance and customer behavior to identify trends, opportunities, and recommendations.

  • Conduct competitive and market research to inform marketing strategies.

  • Leverage data and insights to improve audience targeting, messaging, and marketing effectiveness.

  • Track key performance indicators and communicate results to stakeholders.

About You

You're a curious, results-driven marketer who can seamlessly switch between generating leads, building brand awareness, driving consumer engagement, and supporting client marketing needs. You thrive in a dynamic environment where wearing multiple hats is the norm, and you're always willing to jump in and help teammates move projects forward. You think strategically but aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves and execute, balancing thoughtful planning with a bias for action and speed. You excel at managing multiple priorities, collaborating across teams, and turning ideas into high-quality marketing programs quickly and efficiently. Most importantly, you're passionate about creating meaningful marketing experiences that help more people discover and engage with One Pass while delivering value for our clients, partners, and members.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

  • 4-6 years of experience in marketing, brand management, demand generation, or related disciplines.

  • Experience supporting B2B marketing and lead generation initiatives.

  • Experience developing and executing B2B2C marketing campaigns.

  • Experience creating marketing collateral, sales enablement materials, and client-facing communications.

  • Experience partnering across cross-functional teams to drive marketing initiatives and business results.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, fitness, benefits, or consumer subscription businesses.

  • Knowledge of employer-sponsored benefits, health plans, or member engagement strategies.

  • Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and digital marketing platforms.

  • Familiarity with performance marketing, content marketing, and campaign analytics.

Work Location & Eligibility

One Pass Solutions, Inc. offers a flexible work environment. We operate as a hybrid company in the Minnesota–St. Paul Twin Cities area, where team members are expected to work in-office three days per week. We also support remote work across a number of U.S. states.

We are currently able to employ individuals who reside in the following states:

Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, D.C.

Please note: At this time, we are unable to employ individuals residing outside of these jurisdictions.


One Pass Solutions, Inc. commits to provide a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, as well as equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. You may view all of One Pass Solutions, Inc.’s recruiting notices here, including our EEO policy, recruitment agency policy, recruitment scam notice, and important E-Verify information.

Compensation Range: $79K - $106.5K

40

$86,300 - $118,700 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to elevate our brand presence across digital channels. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that drive engagement, increase conversions, and boost overall online visibility. Your expertise in a wide range of digital tools and platforms will be essential to crafting compelling content, managing paid advertising campaigns, and analyzing performance metrics to inform strategic decisions. Join us to shape innovative marketing initiatives that captivate audiences and generate measurable growth!

Duties

  • Plan, execute, and manage integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, and social media channels.
  • Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings and improve website visibility.
  • Create engaging content for websites, blogs, email marketing, and social media to attract and retain target audiences.
  • Manage website content using content management systems like WordPress and optimize site performance through technical SEO practices.
  • Design visually appealing graphics and banners using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite for digital ads and social media posts.
  • Monitor campaign performance using web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms; generate detailed reports to track KPIs.
  • Oversee paid advertising campaigns including SEM (Search Engine Marketing) and paid search marketing strategies to maximize ROI.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on website management, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
  • Implement tracking pixels, set up conversion tracking, and analyze data to refine targeting strategies for better campaign outcomes.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends in digital marketing, social media advertising campaigns, and emerging tools to continuously improve our strategies.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEO tools, SEM, paid advertising campaign management, and analytics platforms.
  • Proficiency in website management systems such as WordPress; familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL is highly desirable.
  • Skilled in using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Creative Suite for graphic design tasks related to digital campaigns.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads (formerly Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation tools.
  • Strong copywriting skills coupled with the ability to craft compelling content tailored for diverse audiences across multiple channels.
  • Knowledge of web analytics reporting techniques to measure campaign success and inform future strategies.
  • Technical proficiency in website optimization techniques including keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with a proactive approach to collaboration across teams such as sales, creative services, and IT.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will drive impactful campaigns! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values creativity, analytical thinking, and continuous learning—all while offering paid positions that recognize your expertise!

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

  • SEO: 3 years (Required)
  • Digital marketing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Lifecycle Marketing Manager

PlanHub is the leading pre-construction SaaS platform and marketplace helping general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers connect and grow their businesses. Built with tradespeople in mind, PlanHub is designed around the user workflow to help boost productivity, maintain deadlines, increase revenue, and create relationships. Easily post projects or submit bids with anytime-anywhere collaboration for every commercial construction trade.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help users move from registration to their first valuable outcome, and from there to regular, long-term use.

This is a strategy and execution role. You will define user journeys, build programs directly in HubSpot, own lifecycle messaging and cadence, and measure results. You will also help shape the lifecycle requirements for our planned email platform and user-profile migration.

We are looking for someone who can set direction, build and optimize programs independently, and use data to prioritize opportunities across lifecycle stages and channels.


What you'll do to make an impact:
  • Define user lifecycle journeys, activation milestones, and progression criteria in partnership with Marketing Operations and Product, with distinct programs for general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Design, build, and optimize HubSpot workflows for onboarding, activation, plan upgrades from Basic to Premier, retention, and win-back.
  • Own lifecycle messaging, copy, cadence, and campaign execution, partnering with Product Marketing and Design on positioning and creative.
  • Segment and personalize communications by trade, geography, behavior, and plan, working with Product on the signals that make project recommendations relevant.
  • Plan and manage communications across email, in-app messaging, and additional channels where they improve results.
  • Run experiments with clear hypotheses, success measures, and appropriate comparison groups to understand the effect on activation, repeat usage, retention, and upgrades.
  • Build and maintain lifecycle reporting in partnership with Marketing Operations, including cohort and funnel analysis, and communicate findings to Marketing, Product, and leadership.
  • Lead lifecycle program requirements for the planned email platform and user-profile migration, partnering with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering on event definitions, consent and suppression needs, vendor evaluation, and launch validation.
  • Monitor email engagement, deliverability, and suppression practices, working with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering to maintain healthy sending practices.


What you will accomplish in your first 90 days:
  • Audit existing lifecycle programs, workflows, and data availability, and recommend a prioritized lifecycle roadmap.
  • Launch or improve activation programs for general contractor and subcontractor users.
  • Establish a lifecycle dashboard with agreed activation definitions and baseline cohort reporting, including 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention where historical data is available.
  • Deliver a lifecycle requirements document for the planned migration, including program priorities, required events and attributes, consent and suppression needs, and launch acceptance criteria.


What will make you stand out:
  • Five or more years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation, ideally in a marketplace, product-led, or SaaS business with a high-volume user base.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lists, properties, segmentation, and the underlying data model.
  • Strong analytical skills, including cohort and funnel analysis, experiment design, and experience using SQL or a business intelligence tool.
  • Experience running high-volume email programs, including campaigns and automated sends, with examples of tests you ran and results you improved.
  • Experience building behavioral and event-triggered programs.
  • A record of setting lifecycle strategy and personally building, launching, and optimizing the programs.
  • Strong copywriting skills and the ability to turn product value into clear, relevant customer communications.
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, consent management, suppression practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Experience with a customer data platform (CDP).
  • Experience with Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or a similar orchestration platform.
  • Experience supporting an email platform migration or implementing new behavioral data and messaging capabilities.
  • Background in B2B marketplaces, construction, or SMB customers.
  • Knowledge of email deliverability and compliance requirements.


How we will measure success:
Success will be measured by improvements in activation, repeat usage, 90-day retention, and upgrades and reactivation attributable to lifecycle programs, alongside healthy unsubscribe, complaint, bounce, and deliverability metrics.


What's in it for you:

Location
Fully Remote

Schedule
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type
Full-time independent contractor

About RevSpark Media
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

About the Role
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

Your First Focus
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

What You'll Do
Testing Strategy

  • Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
  • Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
  • Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
  • Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

Account Structure and Quality Standards

  • Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
  • Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
  • Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
  • Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

Strategic Direction

  • Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
  • Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
  • Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
  • Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

Performance Analysis

  • Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
  • Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
  • Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
  • Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

Client Support, As Needed

  • Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
  • Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

Why Work With Us

  • Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
  • Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
  • Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
  • Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
  • Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
  • A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
  • Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
  • Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
  • Strong written communication and documentation habits.

Nice to have

  • Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
  • Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
  • Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

SEO Strategy and Optimization:

  • Ensure healthcare-related content is accurate, trustworthy, accessible, and appropriately reviewed.

Digital Advertising and Conversion Optimization:

Send your CV and portfolio (or examples of SEO results/projects) to hr@blizecare.com
